verdict.rationale: Martin documents several scheduled background tasks that run automatically and report back: daily or weekly email briefings, a recurring morning wake-up call with weather and schedule, and one-off reminders that ping you at a specified time through a chosen interface. However, these are fixed, predefined task types. Reminders only notify you rather than execute work, and shortcuts are multi-step but not shown to be schedulable. missing for 10: arbitrary user-defined scheduled tasks (recurring or one-off) that execute custom multi-step work, scheduling of shortcuts, documentation of how scheduled results are delivered for custom tasks, independent or hands-on corroboration of scheduled execution.
